heroHeadline: Russian Drone Crosses From Moldova Into Romania as Chisinau's Pro-EU Government Reels From Collapse
heroSubtitle: Since Putin's May 15 decree fast-tracking Russian citizenship for Transnistria's roughly 220,000 residents and authorising presidential use of force abroad, pressure on Moldova has escalated: Prime Minister Alexandru Munteanu resigned on July 3, collapsing the pro-EU coalition, and around July 6 Chisinau ordered the Russian cultural centre closed over security and drone concerns. On August 16 a Russian drone crossed from Moldovan into Romanian airspace, underscoring the region's exposure as Moldova's EU accession track and energy security — heavily dependent on Transnistria's Cuciurgan power plant — remain under strain.
footerNote: Data sourced from official reports, major outlets, and institutional analyses.
